results.title: OMI Reviews | Read Customer Service Reviews of omi.me
results.content:
I bought the Omi in late September 2026 (A$292.73 for the device and accessories) and paid another US$269.91 (A$402.01) for the yearly Omi Pro plan on 10 October. I wanted it for one simple thing: capture my conversations and give me a reliable daily summary.  
Here's what happened:  
\- 16 Oct: I reported spike noise on my recordings. It was never resolved, and support later told me they couldn't even open that ticket.  
\- Early Nov: conversations kept failing with "Omi couldn't finish" and "Summary failed". On 5 Nov alone, four sessions in a row failed.  
\- 12 Nov: after an app update, I couldn't read anything at all, so I opened a new ticket.  
\- 13 Nov: a few files briefly synced, then everything stopped again. [...] \- When I asked for a fix date or a refund, they refused, citing their 30-day return window and 7-day subscription refund window, as if a faulty product were the same as a change of mind. The only thing they offered was to turn off auto-renewal.  
The result: my data is locked on their servers, the product doesn't do what it's sold for, and I've spent hours troubleshooting and chasing support for a device that was supposed to save me time.  
If you're thinking about buying Omi, especially the Pro plan, don't. If something goes wrong, you're on your own. [...] \- Since then: nothing new in the app. The diagnostics show 0 of 11,235 server jobs completed, with 42,012 audio files stuck.  
How support responded:  
\- First they told me all my recent recordings had been "processed successfully". My own diagnostics showed that wasn't true.  
\- Then they admitted it's a sync and processing fault on their side going back to 11 Nov, but couldn't give a fix date or any way to export my recordings.  
\- They asked me not to uninstall or reset the device, so I can't use it and I can't do anything about it either.
